what_it_is.quote: Word or Excel starting cmd.exe or powershell.exe.

injection_found.quote: paste into the notes field.

esql.query: from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where (ends_with(process.parent.executable.caseless, "\\winword.exe") or ends_with(process.parent.executable.caseless, "\\excel.exe")) and (ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\cmd.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\powershell.exe"))

kql.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\winword.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\excel.exe") and (FolderPath endswith "\\cmd.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\powershell.exe")

title: Office application starts a shell
triage_tips: Ask the user what file they opened.
Known false positive: macro-based finance workbooks.
what_it_is: Detection for Word or Excel starting cmd.exe or powershell.exe on Windows process creation events.
why_it_flags: A parent of winword.exe or excel.exe spawning cmd.exe or powershell.exe matches the selection; the rule level is high.
